title: HS60068: Hr Accounting
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Development of state-of-the-art human resource accounting; Role and uses of
human resource accounting; Corporate financial reporting; Accounting and
measuring human resource costs; First and second generation accounting systems:
concepts and methods; Accounting for HR value, determining HR value; Monetary
and non-monetary measurement methods, first- second- and third-generation
accounting systems for HR value, Implementing and designing HR accounting
systems: applications for improving management, training, and personnel
decisions, developing an integrated systems, advancements and future directions
in HR accounting.
